patterns.description: Namespaced singleton CR named default with CEL enforcement — not cluster-scoped cluster singleton
Limited teardown on CR delete — stop reconciliation only; manual cleanup documented as non-goal
Addon controllers must use unified ctrl.Manager cache — no separate per-controller cache
Ready condition must be set when operand is healthy — status state machine completeness
OLM upgrade path when adding new owned CRD to operator bundle
Operand version skew with platform dependency (OSSM/Istio minimum versions)
Documentation placeholder naming consistency across examples
GA API fields: istioDataPlaneNamespaceSelector, istioCACertificate, server.clusterID

issues.pattern: Separate controller cache caused reconcile skip on CR creation
issues.eval_implication: Constitution and implementation evals must require unified manager cache for addons

issues.pattern: Ready condition not set when deployment became ready
issues.eval_implication: Tasks must pair status condition implementation with e2e Ready assertion

issues.pattern: CRD shortname change broke OLM 1.17→1.18 upgrade
issues.eval_implication: Validation must flag missing OLM upgrade test plan when new CRD added

issues.pattern: Bindata operand version below OSSM v3 minimum
issues.eval_implication: Plan verification matrix must include platform version compatibility

issues.pattern: Inconsistent namespace placeholders in integration docs
issues.eval_implication: Tasks must include docs AC for placeholder naming consistency
